<td class="doxyMemberIndexDescriptionRight">
<p>Get the panel identified by init-&gt;common_name, creating it (via init) if it does not exist yet. <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelinit">QarGuiPanelInit</a> supports <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelurlext">QarGuiPanelUrlExt</a> for browser content and <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelstreamidext">QarGuiPanelStreamIdExt</a> for logical-stream content. Chain exactly one through QarGuiPanelInit::header.next. With neither extension, the panel starts with the default website content. <div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Extension: the peers whose gestures may move or scale the app.</p>


<p>Chain from QarAppVolumeGestureConfiguration::header.next. A configuration without it, or with no peers in it, lets every peer's gestures move and scale the app. A gesture from a peer not in the list still reaches the app, unmapped, so the app knows about it; only the app transform is kept from it. A configuration is replaced whole, so chain the extension every time the configuration is changed. Read the list back with <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#ga75360b0c91e05e88f2055956f68446bb">qar_app_volume_get_gesture_allowed_peers()</a>.</p>


<p>Whatever the list, only one peer at a time manipulates a volume: the first whose manipulation binds holds it until that manipulation ends. See <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#gaaa82c086a96788ab7036cdf116ac3ac2">qar_app_volume_get_gesture_holder()</a>.</p>

### QarAppVolumeSize {#a4a5089fbdc7a94519206b359af57cfa0}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">typedef struct QarAppVolumeSize QarAppVolumeSize</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The three frames every app volume API is expressed in.</p>


<p>An app volume is a cuboid placed in the room that reserves the region a remote 3D application renders into.</p>


<p><b>Room space</b> is the session's shared tracking space: right-handed, metres, +Y up. <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarappvolumeinit/#a27fd0d3ea7c3b277ecea35a563680454">QarAppVolumeInit::pose</a>, <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#ga0f57f76fe79b59f34ed4c4d2d2e2875d">qar_app_volumes_change_pose()</a> and <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#ga0b2414ac9f19997acac1e9ba039b6afc">qar_app_volume_get_pose()</a> are given in it.</p>


<p><b>App volume space</b> is the frame that pose defines. Its origin is the <em>centre of the cuboid</em> - not a corner, and not a point on the floor - and its axes are right-handed, laid out so that an unrotated volume stands upright in the room:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>+X spans width_meters,</li>
<li>+Y spans height_meters and points up,</li>
<li>+Z spans length_meters, the horizontal depth. The cuboid therefore covers x in [-width_meters/2, +width_meters/2], y in [-height_meters/2, +height_meters/2] and z in [-length_meters/2, +length_meters/2].</li>
</ul>

<p><b>App content space</b> is the coordinate system of the application rendering into the volume. <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarappvolumeinit/#a53c0d7e8913ea5794ae8a7e149a15706">QarAppVolumeInit::app_pose</a> and <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-app-volumes/#gab61a244bdab51ef38d6920aa9674f8b3">qar_app_volumes_change_app_pose()</a> place that application's origin inside app volume space, in volume metres; <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarappvolumeinit/#a2cddc63926ca9a508a916e1519b9525c">QarAppVolumeInit::app_scale</a> converts app metres into volume metres. Nothing clips the application to the cuboid - the volume states where the app is meant to be, and gestures and layout are derived from it.</p>


<p>Definition at line <a href="#l00994">994</a> of file <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h">qar_streaming.h</a>.</p>

</div>
</div>

### QarGuiPanelSize {#a2a75e919ebe43e27eb671dec96408545}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">
<td class="doxyMemberLabelsLeft">
<table class="doxyMemberName">
<tr>
<td class="doxyMemberName">typedef struct QarGuiPanelSize QarGuiPanelSize</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>The three frames every GUI panel API is expressed in.</p>


<p><b>Room space</b> is the session's shared tracking space: right-handed, metres, +Y up. Every <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarpose">QarPose</a> in the GUI panel API - <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelinit/#ad23ccc05995e70c8ab57cd5f86666f58">QarGuiPanelInit::pose</a>, <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-gui/#ga88a8b5119ef11a2dc70d8b054c2ea95f">qar_gui_panels_update_pose()</a>, <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-gui/#ga27f046c6022215093fa6305ee1aa95a1">qar_gui_panel_get_pose()</a> - is given in it.</p>


<p><b>Panel space</b> is the frame that pose defines. Its origin is the midpoint of the panel's top edge - the top <em>centre</em>, not a corner - and its axes are right-handed, described here as a viewer facing the panel front sees them:</p>


<ul class="doxyList ">
<li>+X runs along the top edge to the viewer's left,</li>
<li>+Y runs up,</li>
<li><b>-Z</b> is the front-face normal and points at the viewer. The front normal is -Z, not +Z: left x up points <em>away</em> from the viewer, so a +Z viewer-facing normal would not be right-handed. The renderer agrees - the panel surface sits at its bounds' minimum Z and the interaction volume grows along StereoKit's vec3_forward, (0, 0, -1). The panel surface therefore covers x in [-width_meters/2, +width_meters/2] and y in [-height_meters, 0], hanging below its own pose.</li>
</ul>

<p><b>Panel content space</b> is the 2D pixel raster drawn onto that surface: the browser bitmap of a QAR_GUI_PANEL_CONTENT_TYPE_WEBSITE_URI panel, or the decoded video image of a QAR_GUI_PANEL_CONTENT_TYPE_STREAM_ID one. Its origin is the panel's top-left corner as the viewer sees it, +X runs right and +Y runs down, and it is the frame <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelpoint">QarGuiPanelPoint</a> reports positions in. Panel content space runs backwards along both panel axes: content x = 0 sits at panel-space +width_meters/2 and content y = 0 at panel-space 0, the top edge, so content x advances along panel-space -X and content y along panel-space -Y. Panel content space is mapped onto panel space by <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qarguipanelsize/#ab010ed5f80f1d333bf08edf1fb15684e">QarGuiPanelSize::content_scale</a>.</p>


<p>Definition at line <a href="#l00857">857</a> of file <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/files/qar-streaming-c/include/qar-streaming-h">qar_streaming.h</a>.</p>

</div>
</div>

<p>The invite is served only by the hub running on this machine, and is always a one-time invite: the hub remembers the device so it is visible in the visualizer, but never marks it for automatic re-invite. Only an operator acting in the visualizer can do that.</p>

<p>Says which of a peer's two hands a gesture came from, and the handedness of a geo anchor frame's axes (right-handed: axis_x_world x axis_y_world = axis_z_world).</p>


<p>QAR_HANDEDNESS_UNSPECIFIED is the zero value, so a zero-initialized struct never claims a side by accident. A gesture made with both hands together reports it; a <a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/structs/qargeoanchorframe">QarGeoAnchorFrame</a> carrying it is rejected with QAR_STATUS_ARGUMENT_NOT_SUPPORTED.</p>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00127"></a>127</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00128"></a>128</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * The spaces are the ones the developer guide describes, under the same names:</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00129"></a>129</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * https://docs.quaternar.com/docs/developer-guide/coordinate-systems/</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00130"></a>130</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00131"></a>131</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * A QarVector3, QarQuaternion or QarPose carries no space of its own. Every</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00132"></a>132</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * field and function that holds one names the space it is in, with one of the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00133"></a>133</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * names below. The C API converts no coordinates: each value is exactly what</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00134"></a>134</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * the library produced.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00135"></a>135</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00136"></a>136</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * Every 3D space follows OpenXR: right-handed, Y-up, -Z forward, so a view</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00137"></a>137</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * looks along -Z. A pose is a position vector plus an orientation quaternion,</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00138"></a>138</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * stored x, y, z, w.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00139"></a>139</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00140"></a>140</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **World space.** Optional, Earth-fixed: ECEF WGS84, metres, double</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00141"></a>141</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   precision. A world anchor pins an app volume to it. See QarGeoAnchorFrame.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00142"></a>142</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **Room space.** The shared frame every peer in a session places things in,</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00143"></a>143</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   in metres. App volume poses (QarAppVolumeInit::pose) and GUI panel poses</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00144"></a>144</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   (QarGuiPanelInit::pose) are in it. Its origin is set by the XR runtime's</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00145"></a>145</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   relocalization, not by applications.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00146"></a>146</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **App volume space.** One app volume's local frame, a box in the room:</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00147"></a>147</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   origin at the cuboid centre, +X along width, +Y up along height, +Z along</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00148"></a>148</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   length, in metres. The app pose (QarAppVolumeInit::app_pose) and the deltas</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00149"></a>149</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   of a mapped app volume gesture are in it. See QarAppVolumeSize.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00150"></a>150</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **App content space.** The application's own world inside the box, the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00151"></a>151</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   space it renders in: app volume space taken into the app pose, positions</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00152"></a>152</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   divided by the app scale, so in app metres. A render sender hands out</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00153"></a>153</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   everything in its app volume's app content space - view poses, hand aim</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00154"></a>154</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   poses, hand joint poses, joint radii and joint velocities - and takes the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00155"></a>155</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   rendered pose back in it; a mapped app volume gesture's start and action</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00156"></a>156</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   points are in it too, so an application uses them as they come. A render</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00157"></a>157</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   sender whose volume does not resolve hands out nothing rather than room</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00158"></a>158</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   space (QAR_STATUS_RENDERING_PRODUCER_APP_VOLUME_UNRESOLVED).</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00159"></a>159</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **View space.** One render view's camera frame, looking along -Z. QarFov</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00160"></a>160</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   angles are in it, in radians.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00161"></a>161</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **Panel space** and **panel content space.** A GUI panel's local frame in</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00162"></a>162</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   metres, and the pixel raster drawn onto it. See QarGuiPanelSize.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00163"></a>163</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - **Texture pixels.** Positions inside a video texture, for frame layouts.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00164"></a>164</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   See QarVideoFrameView.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00165"></a>165</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00166"></a>166</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * The rule (ADR-0253): what a render sender hands its application is in app</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00167"></a>167</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * content space. What arrives through data streams and shared objects - app</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00168"></a>168</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * volume and GUI panel state, another peer's published data - is in the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00169"></a>169</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * publishing peer's room space, and is never converted for you.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00170"></a>170</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00171"></a>171</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @section qar_text_encoding Text encoding</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00172"></a>172</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00173"></a>173</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * Every `const char*` the API takes or hands back is UTF-8, paths included,</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00174"></a>174</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * whatever the host process's ANSI code page. A path under a user profile</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00175"></a>175</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * named with a non-ASCII character must be passed as UTF-8, not in the code</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00176"></a>176</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * page: on Windows convert from UTF-16 with</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00177"></a>177</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * `WideCharToMultiByte(CP_UTF8, ...)`. The C# binding converts its UTF-16</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00178"></a>178</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * strings to UTF-8 itself.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00179"></a>179</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00180"></a>180</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * Any string may hold any Unicode text - display names, paths, GUI panel</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00181"></a>181</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * URLs, hostnames, codes, connection strings, app version and peer info -</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00182"></a>182</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * except a common name: it is an identity key and must be ASCII, and</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00183"></a>183</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * qar_app_volumes_get_or_create() / qar_gui_panels_get_or_create() reject</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00184"></a>184</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * any other. Put non-ASCII text in the display name.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00185"></a>185</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> */</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00810"></a>810</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * **Panel space** is the frame that pose defines. Its origin is the midpoint of</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00821"></a>821</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * and y in [-height_meters, 0], hanging below its own pose.</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l00828"></a>828</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * content space runs backwards along both panel axes: content x = 0 sits at</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03367"></a>3367</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * the subscribe call. The callback runs on a library background thread, so it</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03368"></a>3368</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * must not block and must not call back into a subscribe function.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03369"></a>3369</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03370"></a>3370</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * It is a handle rather than a struct so the event can gain fields - a</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03371"></a>3371</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * contact's depth off the glass, a pressure, a viewport rect - by appending an</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03372"></a>3372</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * accessor, which is an additive change, instead of growing a struct, which</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03373"></a>3373</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * would break every compiled consumer.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03374"></a>3374</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> */</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03375"></a><a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-gui/#ga3433e0955033839df9d08901b0812355">3375</a></span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightKeyword">typedef</span><span class="doxyHighlight"> void (*<a href="/api/qar-streaming-c/groups/qar-c-gui/#ga3433e0955033839df9d08901b0812355">qar_gui_panel_gesture_event_callback_t</a>)(</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03376"></a>3376</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">    <a href="#a9261b59276b0eef7ca6c02e9a821980a">QarGuiPanelGesture</a>* gesture, </span><span class="doxyHighlightKeywordType">void</span><span class="doxyHighlight">* user_state</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03377"></a>3377</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlight">);</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03378"></a>3378</span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03379"></a>3379</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment">/**</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03380"></a>3380</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @brief Subscribe to the gestures the rendering peers report for one panel.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03381"></a>3381</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03382"></a>3382</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * Panel input is one stream of gestures: hover, tap, long press and drag, each</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03383"></a>3383</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * carrying the QarGesturePhase lifecycle and a gesture id that pairs a started</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03384"></a>3384</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * phase with its updates and its end. The peer that draws the panel recognises</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03385"></a>3385</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * them from its user's hand joints - the thresholds are physical, in</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03386"></a>3386</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * millimetres of hand travel against tracking jitter, which a consumer seeing</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03387"></a>3387</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * only content pixels cannot reproduce. The consumer decides for itself whether</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03388"></a>3388</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * a drag is a slider or a scroll.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03389"></a>3389</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03390"></a>3390</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * **One subscription delivers one kind**, the same way</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03391"></a>3391</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * qar_app_volumes_subscribe_gesture_events() does. A consumer that wants</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03392"></a>3392</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * several kinds subscribes several times. Every kind still travels on the one</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03393"></a>3393</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * panel topic and the filtering happens on the receiving side, so a</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03394"></a>3394</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * subscription never misses an event of its kind; what it does not get is an</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03395"></a>3395</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * order guarantee *between* its subscriptions. Where that matters - a hover and</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03396"></a>3396</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * a drag from the same contact - take both kinds on one subscription's worth of</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03397"></a>3397</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * state and reconcile them on the gesture id, which is shared across kinds</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03398"></a>3398</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * within a source peer.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03399"></a>3399</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03400"></a>3400</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * **Several producers publish here.** Recognition happens once per user, in the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03401"></a>3401</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * mixer that serves that user, so a panel several users can see carries one</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03402"></a>3402</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * publisher per user on this single topic. Therefore:</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03403"></a>3403</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - The gesture id is unique only within a source peer id. Key lifecycles on</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03404"></a>3404</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   the pair that qar_gui_panel_gesture_get_lifecycle() returns together: two</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03405"></a>3405</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   users' first drags both carry gesture id 1 A consumer that keys on the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03406"></a>3406</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   gesture id alone works perfectly until a second user joins.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03407"></a>3407</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - Ordering holds within one producer's stream, not across producers. That is</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03408"></a>3408</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   sufficient, because no lifecycle spans two producers.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03409"></a>3409</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - A source peer id never seen before is a new user, not an error, and</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03410"></a>3410</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   per-user interaction state - a slider's value while it is being dragged -</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03411"></a>3411</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   is held per peer so two users do not fight over one.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03412"></a>3412</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - A live lifecycle is republished every 250 ms even when nothing changed.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03413"></a>3413</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   Treat one silent for three of those intervals as cancelled. That, and not</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03414"></a>3414</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   the peer list, is what recovers a producer that crashed: the source peer id</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03415"></a>3415</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   is the headset, while the process that can die is the mixer, which the</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03416"></a>3416</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   event does not name.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03417"></a>3417</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * - A started phase that was never seen is recoverable, because every update</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03418"></a>3418</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *   carries its start position.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03419"></a>3419</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03420"></a>3420</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * Every panel reports gestures, QAR_GUI_PANEL_CONTENT_TYPE_WEBSITE_URI panels</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03421"></a>3421</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * included: nothing branches on content type on the publish path.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03422"></a>3422</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03423"></a>3423</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param session Session owning the panel; must not be NULL.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03424"></a>3424</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param id Panel to observe; must not be NULL, and the default all-zero id is</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03425"></a>3425</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *           rejected with QAR_STATUS_GUI_PANEL_INVALID_ID.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03426"></a>3426</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param gesture_kind The single gesture kind this subscription delivers;</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03427"></a>3427</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *                     subscribe again for another kind.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03428"></a>3428</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param callback Invoked for every gesture event of that kind; must not be</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03429"></a>3429</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *                 NULL.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03430"></a>3430</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param user_state Opaque pointer passed back to @p callback; may be NULL.</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03431"></a>3431</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @param token Cancel token ending the subscription, or NULL to keep it alive</span></span></div>
<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03432"></a>3432</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> *              until the session is destroyed. See</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03434"></a>3434</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * @return QarResult Success once the subscription is running.</span></span></div>

<div class="doxyCodeLine"><span class="doxyLineNumber"><a id="l03454"></a>3454</span><span class="doxyLineContent"><span class="doxyHighlightComment"> * **Prefer this when you take more than one kind.** Everything arrives on one</span></span></div>
